author: NBbowler
quote: As someone who played this series since GTA 3, this is incredibly disappointing.  Rockstar has removed a lot of the staples of the series that made this what it is today, or they locked it behind several hours of tedious fetch quests and storylines before you can get to what made GTA, GTA in the first place.  And even then, a lot of it has been altered to where it’s simply not the same.  The graphics, as many have stated, are wonderful.  However, that can only carry you so far when a game’s story and characters are tedious, un relatable, and ultimately forgettable.  This game was a serious letdown, and I feel guilty of buying into the hype of all the reviewers.  Clearly we were NOT playing the same game.
